Comment: Permissions for .github/workflows/deploy-platform.yml. Attach to the role named by the AWS_ROLE_ARN repository variable, alongside github-staging-policy.json — this one covers the three-service platform stack, that one covers the single-app staging stack, and neither grants the other's resources. Replace 851725383246 and femi9plat-staging if your account id or name prefix differs.

Statement.Comment: One repo per service. Named explicitly rather than with a wildcard so this role cannot push into the single-app stack's repository, or any other repo that appears in the account later.
GetAuthorizationToken has no resource to scope to — it is account-wide by design. The push permissions above are what actually bound this.
RegisterTaskDefinition cannot be scoped to a family by IAM, so the region condition is the only available bound. UpdateService IS scoped, below.
Scoped to this cluster's three services. Without this, a role that can RegisterTaskDefinition could point ANY service in the account at an arbitrary image.

RegisterTaskDefinition needs PassRole for the roles the definition names. Listing exactly the six this stack creates is what stops a compromised workflow from registering a task that assumes something more privileged.
